title: clematis manipurensis
intro: Clematis manipurensis, commonly known as the Manipuri clematis, is a species of flowering plant in the genus Clematis. The Manipuri clematis is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Manipur region of India, where it is valued for its potential health benefits. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Clematis manipurensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
